title: What If You Were Born With No Immune System?

scenes.text: What if your body had no immune defense at all? Some babies are born that way.
The condition is called SCID. Babies look healthy at birth, then infections they cannot fight take over.
Untreated, it is usually fatal within the first year or two of life.
The fix is a stem cell transplant that rebuilds the immune system from donor cells.
Since 2005, a screening test from NIH scientists can catch it from a single drop of blood.
Babies caught by screening and transplanted between 2010 and 2018 had a 92 percent chance of reaching age five.

description:
What if you were born with no immune system?
SCID is rare, and screening plus transplants now saves most babies.
